text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki! She's given us the 
magnificent race we all hoped for!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You've polished it even further! With 
explosive power like a rocket—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, Fuji Kiseki is definitely taking the 
Triple Crown this year! I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Everyone is counting on me!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, after finishing the race. 
While taking a walk to digest my food—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki was doing some training.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! Ah, I'm sorry for not telling 
you anything!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um, your next race is finally the first 
leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the 
Satsuki Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heavily advertised and broadcasted, this 
is one of the most high-profile races in 
the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is waiting with high hopes for 
me. Just thinking about it makes me unable 
to sit still."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must be feeling a considerable amount 
of pressure. I can't let her shoulder it 
all alone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Really? Are you sure? But aren't you tired 
today...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I see!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I think I'll take you up on 
that! Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, training right up until curfew 
began.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah... How was my time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I show her the stopwatch in my hand. It 
was a solid time, close to her personal 
best. However—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Still got a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If I want to put on the show everyone 
desires, just running and winning isn't 
enough."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can run in a way that pushes 
beyond top speed, taking that extra step 
past my limits.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it's going to be a race that 
surprises everyone, but..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I guess pacing is key after all. I'll push 
just a bit further and test my limits!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Fuji Kiseki engaged in 
continuous trial and error, aiming for 
even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is way too much volume for a single 
day of training. Thinking this is the last 
set, I look up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There she was, dashing through with 
sensational speed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: More, even more...! Even further ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Top speed increases even further. Dirt 
flies, and the wind roars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rocket-like acceleration. No, an explosive 
burst of late speed that went beyond such 
metaphors, shooting forth like a meteor—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All alone under the moonlight, Fuji Kiseki 
crossed the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaaah――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard cheers... cheers that 
couldn't possibly be there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... haah... Trainer, how was that time 
just now!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh!? There's a stopwatch on the 
ground!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was so captivated watching them run 
that I must've dropped it without 
realizing...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all... The speed Fuji Kiseki showed 
at the end was faster than anything seen 
before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she can unleash performance like that, 
achieving the Triple Crown becomes a real 
possibility. And above all—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I felt like I was witnessing 
the sheer depth of Fuji Kiseki's talent as 
an entertainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heavily advertised and broadcasted, this 
is one of the most high-profile races in 
the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is waiting with high hopes for 
me. Just thinking about it makes me unable 
to sit still."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything I can do for her as she 
gives her all toward the grand stage?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, training at the beach feels just 
like summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The cold wind feels great. Alright, I'm 
going in for one more lap!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After thoroughly searching "surprise 
scenic views Kanto" ever since then— we 
came to train at a beach famous for its 
gorgeous scenery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In particular, the view of the setting sun 
is said to be a breathtaking sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And furthermore... There was actually one 
more thing that had been prepared.
choice_data_list:
(I'll make this a success no matter 
what...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I spent all night mastering a 
magic trick."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hope this brings her even a little peace 
of mind. Holding onto that wish, I 
proceeded with training—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, dusk began to settle in.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! It's such a breathtaking 
view, like a painting!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The water's surface is golden. Incredible, 
I had no idea a sunset sky could look like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just watching them blows all my fatigue 
away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that wasn't the only surprise. I 
point up at the evening star shining above 
the setting sun.
choice_data_list: That étoile is perfect for you!
That étoile suits you best of all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an exaggerated flourish of her hand, 
as if plucking a star right from the sky, 
she produces a star-shaped brooch onto her 
palm—
choice_data_list:
And that is why I dedicate this to you... 
Huh!?

And that is why I dedicate this to you... 
Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I intended, but the brooch 
slipped from my fingers, and the surprise 
ended in failure...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly picked up the dropped brooch. 
I couldn't bring myself to look Fuji 
Kiseki in the face.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, why are you apologizing? When you've 
warmed my heart this much!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I had no idea you were thinking about all 
this for me."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I showed you how flustered I 
was the other day? Sorry for worrying you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki picked up the brooch that was 
now covered in sand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What a truly... beautiful Étoile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...So this is how it feels to be on the 
receiving end."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, the two of us thoroughly 
enjoyed the breathtaking view of the sun 
slowly setting."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the Satsuki Sho. I want to 
give Fuji Kiseki my full support!
